preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(l, int) and isinstance(r, int)
preconditions.description: n, l, and r are integers.
n is non-negative and less than 2^50.
l and r are positive integers with r >= l.
The range length r - l is at most 10^5.
r does not exceed the length of the final sequence (which is 2n - 1 for n > 0, and 1 for n = 0).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count of 1s in the range [l, r] of the final sequence.

postconditions.expression: count_ones == sum(1 for i in range(l, r + 1) if get_bit(n, i) == 1)
postconditions.description: count_ones equals the number of positions i in [l, r] where the i-th element of the fully expanded sequence is 1.
